findings.text: blocking: the recorded gate is not the done_when's measure -- no test file importing reckon.crew.obligations ran at base or head in matched arms (base-arm.log runs only the static census tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, which does not import obligations), it ran in place rather than on all_debug, and the fragment's claim that "at the base revision the same file fails the same case" is unsupported because base-arm.log states the new test is absent at that revision; the changed _current_review_in_flight also governs the follower list at obligations.py:1128, so a regression there would land unmeasured.

non-blocking: _delivered_review_run re-implements the review-pointer phase read that recovery_classification.py:666 and recovery_review_dispatch.py:480 already own, and _delivered_review_promotion_command re-reads the same pointer a second time in the same duty build, forking a capability instead of extending its owner.

non-blocking: the delivered branch never compares the head the delivered review read against the run's current head, and the superseded guard only fires when a stored record exists, so a delivered review of a superseded head reads awaiting-promotion and offers a promotion of the old revision while the run still owes a review of the new one.

item_verdicts.diff: one commit read against e52a171; it adds REVIEW_AWAITING_PROMOTION_DUTY_KIND, DELIVERED_REVIEW_PHASES, _recorded_review_run_id, _delivered_review_run and _delivered_review_promotion_command, guards _current_review_in_flight, and adds the delivered branch in _review_duty_item, plus the new test and the fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's new test exists and asserts the behaviour, but its matched importer arms were not run: base-arm.log runs only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, a static staged-write census that never imports reckon.crew.obligations, and no test file importing obligations_module ran at either revision.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a delivered, unpromoted review reads as awaiting promotion; reckon/crew/obligations.py:2143-2185 sets kind review-awaiting-promotion, names the review run and offers its promotion command, so a run whose dispatched review delivered no longer reads review-missing.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 01e38f1509b7, base arm 51 passed EXIT=0 and after arm 54 passed EXIT=0, negative control 1 failed 2 passed EXIT=1, and it discloses that the base reading is no duty at all rather than the plan's review-missing.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declared reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/test_a_delivered_review_reads_as_awaiting_promotion.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff e52a171..01e38f1 touches exactly the first three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows forcing _delivered_review_run to return "" reddens tests/test_a_delivered_review_reads_as_awaiting_promotion.py:198, but the withdrawn and figure-field branches of _recorded_review_run_id at obligations.py:620-632 and the _live_review_runs consequence have no assertion.
justifications.evidence: base-arm.log runs only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py at e52a171 and after-arm.log adds the new test to the same census file, so the done_when's matched importer arms on all_debug are unmeasured while 57 test files import obligations_module.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the module's docstring and naming idiom at reckon/crew/obligations.py:608-680, though DELIVERED_REVIEW_PHASES restates a delivered-run vocabulary the repository already declares at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:2646.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:2143-2185 builds the awaiting-promotion duty with the review run id and the classifier-composed promotion command, which is the goal as stated.
justifications.reuse: _delivered_review_run at reckon/crew/obligations.py:648-668 re-reads a review run's own pointer phase, a capability recovery_classification._review_pointer_phase (reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:666) and recovery_review_dispatch._readable_standing_review (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:480) already own, and extends neither.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only obligations.py, the new test and the fragment, all inside the declared write paths, with no figure and no plan edit.
